entries.speaker: Foulmouthed Male Student
entries.en: It's raining pretty hard. If we don't hurry,[n]we'll get in huge-ass trouble if we're late[n]to school.

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Male Student
entries.en: I heard Sakamoto got in trouble again[n]yesterday, too. He and that transfer[n]student got an earful from the teachers.

entries.speaker: Foulmouthed Male Student
entries.en: School just started, and those two[n]bastards are already getting in trouble?[n]They really just don't care...

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Male Student
entries.en: School's annoying enough as it is, but[n]those two are making even more trouble[n]for everybody else.
